name: B10-0408/2025 – § 1 – Am 4
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the Second World Summit for Social Development
part_text: 1. Considers that the design of social policies must remain under the exclusive sovereignty of the Member States; rejects any attempt by the EU to create a uniform social model undermining national traditions, democratic choices or the protection of citizens against the costs of mass immigration and climate dogmatism;
